paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 68:12; he reported in the name of Reish Lakish.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Bereshit Rabbah 68:12 in Midrash Rabbah -- TE explicitly has רַבִּי שַׂלְמוֹנִי בְּשֵׁם רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ. This supports Rabbi and the Reish Lakish reporting chain for this occurrence. Shelomoni retains the current conventional vocalization; the named text vocalizes the same consonants differently.
פס״ח-יב is read as parashah 68, section 12. ס״ח is 68, not 88; no alternative 88 is implied by these letters.
